title: kithctl JMAP response body read with no size cap — unbounded memory allocation
description: watch.rs:541-548 jmap_post reads the response body via either read_exact(len) or read_to_end with no upper bound. A misbehaving or compromised kithd (or if the listener is somehow reachable by a non-kithd endpoint) can stream a multi-GiB response body and exhaust kithctl memory. Fix: wrap the reader with tokio::io::AsyncReadExt::take(10*1024*1024) before read_to_end, and cap the Content-Length-based path similarly.
